description: Resource Type definition for AWS::CloudWatch::Alert. An alert runs a SQL or PromQL query in a CloudWatch Omni space on a fixed interval, compares the result against warning and critical thresholds, and sends notifications to Amazon SNS topics or integrations when its state changes.

SpaceId.description: The ID of the space to create the alert in. Changing this value replaces the alert.
SpaceId.markdownDescription:
The ID of the space to create the alert in. Changing this value replaces the alert.

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Pattern: ^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$  
Update requires: Replacement

ProfileId.description: The ID of the access profile the alert uses to run its query and send notifications.
ProfileId.markdownDescription:
The ID of the access profile the alert uses to run its query and send notifications.

Name.markdownDescription:
